goal: Security exception gate: each accepted risk recorded with an owner, a reason and an expiry.
use: Security exception gate: each accepted risk recorded with an owner, a reason and an expiry. Use when a gate is bypassed or a finding is accepted.

steps.note: List the exceptions. Each accepted finding, gate or rule.
Check the record. Each needs an owner, a reason and an expiry date.
Check the expiry. Flag exceptions past their date.
Check the approval. Each exception needs an approver above the team.
Report. The exceptions, their status and those that need renewal or closure.
